title: First Agricultural Civilization Large Model Tianji Launched, Using 80 Million Data Points to Bridge the Divide Between Ancient and Modern Agriculture

content_html:
In an era when AI is racing ahead, we seem to have grown used to it writing code, making videos, and advancing scientific research, yet we often overlook the local wisdom that is quietly fading away. Ancient agricultural books sit on shelves unread and undeciphered; traditional farming techniques face the risk of being lost; and modern agriculture, in its pursuit of high yields, often lacks fine-grained guidance rooted in local climate and phenology. This pain point—a rupture between past and present, scattered and isolated data, and a fragmented knowledge system—has become a hidden regret in China's agricultural modernization.

Recently, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs officially released "Tianji," the first large model in the field of agricultural civilization, offering a highly forward-looking digital solution to this industry pain point. The model integrates as many as 80 million knowledge entries in one sweep, spanning traditional farming techniques, modern smart agriculture, and the evolution of agricultural civilization. It marks a shift in AI technology from "general chit-chat" and "purely industrial scenarios" to a deep dive into the oldest and most fundamental soil of agricultural culture.

Technical Insight: A Game-Changing Edge in Multimodality and Spatiotemporal Graphs

Tianji is by no means a simple agricultural text retrieval database. Instead, relying on core technologies such as multimodal large models, spatiotemporal knowledge graphs, and knowledge-enhanced reasoning, it builds a three-dimensional cognitive brain for agriculture. It deeply integrates multidimensional data resources—cross-temporal texts, multi-source audio, video, and images, geographic information, and traditional calendars—and purposefully develops specialized agent modules for intelligent interpretation of ancient agricultural books, application of the 24 Solar Terms, and revitalization of agricultural cultural heritage. This technical architecture truly allows dormant old agricultural wisdom to break free from the limitations of its medium and become "viewable, learnable, and usable."

Application Value: From "Cultural Heritage" to "Productivity Tool"

The ultimate value of a large model lies in real-world empowerment. Tianji can not only digitally reconstruct traditional farm tools and agricultural heritage scenes and precisely break down old farming technique workflows, but also enable intelligent analysis of agricultural civilization knowledge and cross-temporal association and inference. This means that the farming wisdom about solar terms and phenology in ancient agricultural books is no longer just history in dusty archives; it can be transformed into highly practical intelligent decision-making suggestions for modern agricultural production. From precise Q&A to production guidance, traditional experience and modern technology achieve a perfect closed loop here.

The ultimate meaning of technological development lies not only in looking up at the stars to explore the unknown, but also in bending down to the earth to safeguard where we came from. The arrival of Tianji powerfully proves that AI is not merely a showground for cutting-edge computing power, but also a digital bridge that stitches together history and the future and brings cultural heritage back to life. When the oldest farming wisdom meets the most advanced large model, China's agricultural digital transformation is showing a warmth and depth all its own.
